invalidate_if: BAPA formalization produces further recurring negative adjustments, or revenue growth stalls beyond sector-wide softness.
reason: The large BAPA-related prior-period adjustment is a one-time accounting/tax item with an offsetting tax benefit already recognized; no evidence of recurring operational deterioration.
thesis: Quality diversified IT services franchise with strong cash generation across engineering, ER&D and services lines.

invalidate_if: DOJ investigation escalates to charges, material fine, or loss of key US client relationships.
reason: DOJ investigation into H-1B classification is ongoing and undetermined; company itself states it cannot predict materiality. Price decline reflects broad IT derating, not a confirmed fundamental problem.
thesis: Tier-1 IT exporter with strong balance sheet and diversified client base; long horizon allows time for regulatory clarity.

invalidate_if: Related-party dealings expand further without independent pricing/oversight, or standalone earnings fail to scale despite capital deployed.
reason: Trimming on governance concerns: large promoter-group warrant issue and a related-party investment approval sized at 142% of FY26 turnover into an affiliated mutual fund business are unusual scale for related-party capital allocation; sector (NBFC) concentration is also near the 30% cap.
thesis: Optionality on Reliance's financial-services buildout remains, but earnings track record is unproven and PE is already flagged elevated by the exchange (WATCH, PE>50).

invalidate_if: Tax demand is upheld at higher courts, or ED matter escalates to formal charges against the company or its MD.
reason: Tax demand of ~Rs978cr is disputed and under appeal; ED matter from Oct 2025 remains unresolved with company denying direct wrongdoing; subsidiary credit upgrade is a positive counterpoint.
thesis: Dominant asset-backed gold-loan NBFC; collateralized lending model provides a margin of safety that offsets episodic regulatory noise.

invalidate_if: Refinancing and liquidity metrics normalize and Mundra stays online, or conversely if further plant disruptions/adverse arbitration rulings emerge.
reason: Position had drifted to 21.4% weight, above the 20% single-name cap, and the annual report flags a going-concern Key Audit Matter (current liabilities far exceed current assets) alongside a ~9-month Mundra plant shutdown and unresolved Adaro/PMLA litigation - reducing size rather than exiting.
thesis: Diversified generation/transmission/renewables platform with long-term growth optionality; near-term balance-sheet strain argues for a smaller position.

invalidate_if: SIT probe escalates to management-level findings or produces new material provisions/client losses.
reason: DXC/CSC trade-secret litigation is now concluded (Supreme Court cert denied) with damages already provided for; the Nashik SIT probe is reputational and not yet shown to be financially material.
thesis: Bellwether IT franchise with disciplined capital allocation and largest scale in the sector; litigation overhang now resolved.

invalidate_if: Auditor qualifications escalate toward going-concern language, or SEBI enforcement results in a material penalty.
reason: Weight has drifted to 20.9%, just above the 20% single-name cap after price appreciation; trimming back to size. Minor governance friction noted (CARO qualifications, SEBI disclosure-timing violation) but not thesis-breaking.
thesis: Strong regional beverage bottler with expanding international footprint (Africa) and consistent volume growth; core franchise intact.

invalidate_if: Client losses/impairments accelerate further or buyback is shelved/downsized materially.
reason: Buyback of up to Rs15,000cr signals shareholder-friendly capital return and Mindsprint acquisition closed ahead of schedule; intangible impairment and a possible Nifty50 exit are near-term negatives but not fundamental red flags.
thesis: Turnaround IT services story with improving capital discipline; smallest-weight IT holding, kept as a recovery play.

invalidate_if: Evidence of recurring (not one-off) margin erosion, or an adverse BAPA outcome that recurs beyond the disclosed periods.
reason: One-time BAPA tax/accounting adjustment already recognized and disclosed; no new adverse event beyond a routine AGR appeal.
thesis: Large IT services franchise with steady cash generation; price weakness reflects sector-wide multiple compression, not an operating breakdown.

invalidate_if: DOJ investigation escalates to charges, fines, or client contract losses tied to visa practices.
reason: DOJ H-1B investigation is disclosed but outcome and materiality are explicitly unknown; no financial impact yet quantified.
thesis: Tier-1 IT bellwether; long horizon allows riding out a litigation overhang that is common to the sector's US exposure.

invalidate_if: Related-party lending grows further as a share of the book without arm's-length disclosure, or regulator (RBI/SEBI) acts on the concentration.
reason: Governance flags (92% related-party loans, large promoter-linked investment ceiling, warrant issue to promoter group) are material but represent disclosed, board/shareholder-approved related-party structure, not a fresh breach.
thesis: Optionality on India's financial-services buildout via Reliance ecosystem, but position size already reflects that uncertainty.

invalidate_if: Tax demand is upheld at appellate stage, or ED matter implicates the parent entity's own funds/practices.
reason: Rs 977.8cr tax demand and ED questioning of the MD are disclosed, disputed, and not yet adjudicated; credit rating on a subsidiary was upgraded, a mild positive.
thesis: Leading gold-loan NBFC with a durable niche; near-term legal noise doesn't change the underlying lending franchise.

invalidate_if: Refinancing or planned divestments fail to materialize, or the going-concern language persists/worsens in the next filing.
reason: FY26 annual report's going-concern note (current liabilities ~2.5x current assets) alongside the 9-month Mundra shutdown is a real liquidity flag, but price has actually held up and the filing frames it as refinancing-dependent, not insolvency.
thesis: Power/utility exposure with renewables optionality; holding through an operational disruption that management says is resolving.

invalidate_if: SIT probe implicates broader corporate culture/governance failures or draws client attrition.
reason: DXC litigation loss is already provisioned and now final (cert denied); SIT harassment probe is a fresh reputational item to monitor but not yet a financial one.
thesis: India's largest IT services company by scale and margin; price is down mainly on sector sentiment, not a fundamental miss.

invalidate_if: Related-party dealing recurs at unfavorable terms, or SEBI enforcement escalates beyond warnings.
reason: Pattern of related-party deals (Kenya business transfer from promoter group) and a SEBI disclosure violation are governance yellow flags, but position is near breakeven and business fundamentals (seasonal beverage growth) remain intact per prior quarters.
thesis: Structural growth story in Indian beverages/bottling with international expansion; own it for the growth runway, watch the governance pattern.

invalidate_if: Buyback is shelved or downsized materially, or impairments recur suggesting deeper deal write-downs ahead.
reason: Rs 15,000cr buyback is shareholder-friendly and offsets the Nifty-exit headline risk (index-flow driven, not fundamental); intangible impairment reflects already-known revenue softness.
thesis: Smallest of the IT holdings; buyback plus recent Mindsprint acquisition completion signal management confidence despite a rough year.

invalidate_if: Auditor resignation circumstances turn out to involve accounting concerns, or a fresh CCI/regulatory penalty materializes rather than the disclosed legacy ones.
reason: Stock is 27.6% below its 1-year high with no new adverse litigation (all CCI matters are old and stayed/under appeal) and the auditor resignation was explicitly noted as raising no issues; adds a new sector (AUTO) using idle cash within this month's budget.
thesis: India's largest carmaker with a durable moat in the mass-market segment; buying a quality compounder into cyclical/sentiment weakness for a multi-year hold.
